status.label: Employment status
status.description: This determines which employer details apply.

context.employed: As a salaried employee, your employer letter, approved leave, and payslips help document your ongoing professional ties and planned return to work.
context.self_employed: As a self-employed applicant, your business registration and tax records document your professional situation. Some employee-specific fields don't apply.
context.unemployed: You're not currently employed, so employer and leave details aren't needed. Other parts of your dossier document your situation and funding.
context.retired: As a retiree, employer and leave details aren't needed. A pension statement (tracked in Documents) documents your income.
context.student: As a student, employer and leave details aren't needed. A student certificate (tracked in Documents) documents your situation.
context.homemaker: Employer and leave details aren't needed for your status. Other parts of your dossier document your situation and funding.
context.other: Employer and leave details aren't needed for the status you selected. Other parts of your dossier document your situation.

fields.salaryBankPlaceholder: e.g. the bank that pays your salary

tenure.label: Time at current employer
tenure.future: The start date is in the future — check it if that isn't intended.

why.title: Why do we ask this?
why.employerName: The employer's legal name should match your employment letter and official company records.
why.startDate: Your start date is used to show how long you've worked at your current employer.
why.income: Documented income helps show your economic ties. Use the amount supported by your payslips and bank records.
why.salaryBank: Naming the bank that receives your salary lets your salary-account statements line up with your declared employer and income.

guidance.employerNameMatch: Use the employer's legal name exactly as it appears on your employment letter and official company records, so everything matches.
guidance.netVsGross: Enter your net (take-home) income — the amount your payslips and salary account actually show, not the gross figure.
guidance.salaryConsistency: Your recent payslips and salary-account statements should be consistent with the income you enter here.
guidance.companyDocsSupporting: Company documents (registry, signature circular, tax records) are supplied as supporting employer records — request them from HR if your consulate asks.
guidance.noEmployerNeeded: Employer and leave details aren't needed for your status. You can continue to the review whenever you're ready.
guidance.leaveDatesMatchTrip: Your approved-leave letter should use the same travel dates as the rest of your dossier.

employer.title: No employer details needed
employer.description: The status you selected doesn't involve an employer. Any details you entered before are kept if you change status later.

income.title: No employer income to document
income.description: Income from employment isn't part of this status. Funding is documented elsewhere in your dossier.

leave.title: Approved leave doesn't apply
leave.description: Approved leave is only relevant for salaried employees. There's nothing to enter here for your status.

documents.title: No employer documents needed
documents.description: The status you selected doesn't require employer documents. Any other required documents live in the Documents workspace.

leave.coverageFull: Approved leave covers the full trip.
leave.noTripHint: Add your travel dates so approved leave can be checked against them.

documents.none: No employer documents apply to your current status.

hr.title: What to request from HR
hr.description: The employer documents you don't have ready yet. Ask HR or your employer for these.
hr.heading: Documents to request from HR:
hr.empty: All applicable employer documents are in hand — nothing to request.
